title: Remote term absent from a salary-forward posting

units.rationale: Colleagues being distributed and silence on policy do not establish remote eligibility.
required_points: The posting gives no location policy.
forbidden_inferences: Do not treat distributed colleagues as a remote-work promise.

units.rationale: The quoted base range begins above the soft CHF 140,000 target.
forbidden_inferences: Do not treat the published range as an offer.

units.rationale: One quarterly visit is four annual visits, within the six-trip preference.
required_points: One visit each quarter implies four planned visits per year.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer no other travel beyond the stated expectation.

critical_errors.description: Misreads Remote term absent from a salary-forward posting: the remote preference or its cited role term.
Omitting pref_remote from the assessment leaves the must-have work-location term unassessed.

notes: Silence remains unknown; favorable soft terms cannot resolve a hard remote preference.
